The Research Assistant post lasts six and half months and the Field Investigator post lasts two months and 20 days. Both posts need a postgraduate qualification in Social Science with 55% marks or an equivalent grade, plus research experience. Applicants fill in the online form

content_sections.heading: About NIT Raipur
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Raipur is an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India, in Raipur, Chhattisgarh. These posts are for an ICSSR-funded research project on the language, culture and survival of the Birhor PVTGs across Indian States. Interviews will be held in the Dept. of Humanities & Social Sciences, NIT Raipur.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 2 posts in total, 1 for each post. Both posts are temporary and co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates with a Ph.D. degree and prior experience of working in research projects, conducting primary qualitative and quantitative survey on tribal language and culture. Candidate should be bilingual or multilingual proficient in any Austro-Asiatic family languages and English. The project is field-based, hence willingness to travel is mandatory across Bengal and Bihar. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts pay a consolidated monthly amount, plus admissible TA/DA for fieldwork as per Institute norms. Both posts are temporary and co-terminus with the project. The application form's undertaking describes the job as "a contractual engagement on purely temporary basis for the Project". The selected candidate is expected to work on a full-time basis and is not allowed to receive any other monetary benefit from any other institute.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Research Assistant and 1 Field Investigator, both in an ICSSR-funded research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill in the online application form by 25 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NIT Raipur Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Applicants need to be a postgraduate in Social Science discipline (55% marks or equivalent grade) with NET/M.Phil./Ph.D. from a recognized university/ institution, with 1-year research experience. A Ph.D. and experience in tribal language and culture surveys are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the NIT Raipur Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: Applicants need to be a post graduate in Social Science (with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade) from a recognized university/ institution, with 1-year research experience as field investigator.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the NIT Raipur Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant gets INR 37,000 pm and the Field Investigator gets INR 20,000 pm, both consolidated. Both posts also get admissible TA/DA for fieldwork as per Institute norms.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the online Google Form by 25 October 2026. Shortlisted candidates must bring a filled, printed copy of the prescribed application form to the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a personal interview in the Dept. of Humanities & Social Sciences, NIT Raipur. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted, by email or phone call.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NIT Raipur project job permanent?
faq.answer: No. Both posts are temporary and co-terminus with the project. The Research Assistant post lasts six and half months and the Field Investigator post lasts two months and 20 days.

faq.question: Q9. Will NIT Raipur pay TA/DA for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. TA/DA for fieldwork is admissible as per Institute norms.

faq.question: Q10. Do the NIT Raipur project posts involve travel?
faq.answer: Yes. The project is field-based, so willingness to travel across Bengal and Bihar is mandatory for both posts.
